verdict.rationale: The evidence documents official SDKs (exa-py, exa-js), a hosted MCP server, agent skills and a REST API usable via curl, but no official Exa command-line tool. The Stripe Projects single command and `npx skills add` are host-platform or third-party installers, not an Exa CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
